_about: Public-domain John Bramhall (1594-1663), Bishop of Derry and Archbishop of Armagh, for the Word Hoard: his Works with a life of the author in the Library of Anglo-Catholic Theology (Oxford: J. H. Parker, 1842-1845, five volumes), including the Just Vindication of the Church of England and his controversy with Hobbes on liberty and necessity, from Princeton Theological Seminary scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
